te: Lessons from public bus services in Chiang Mai, Khon Kaen and Phuket
se: Meeting on Thursday 3 December 2026 at 09.30 hrs, Meeting Room 202, floor 2, Parliament House. At its meeting on 18 November 2026 the subcommittee decided not to meet on Wednesday 25 November 2026 and to hold its next meeting on this day. The agenda is to consider how public bus services are managed, lessons from their operation, problems and obstacles, and ways to develop them in Chiang Mai, Khon Kaen and Phuket provinces. Representatives of public bus operators in the three provinces are invited, as set out in the meeting notice. A summary will be added after the Senate publishes the meeting summary.
it: How public bus services are managed: lessons, problems, obstacles and ways to develop them in Chiang Mai, Khon Kaen and Phuket

Plans to develop, control and follow ride-hailing services booked through apps
se: Meeting on Wednesday 25 November 2026 at 10.00 hrs, Committee Meeting Room CA 432, floor 4, Parliament House, in place of the meeting on Wednesday 18 November 2026, which did not take place. The agenda is to consider plans to develop, control and follow public ride-hailing services booked through apps. Executives of the ride-hailing platform operators are invited, as set out in the meeting notice. A summary will be added after the Senate publishes the meeting summary.
it: Plans to develop, control and follow public ride-hailing services booked through apps
